Uttarakhand Revenue Officers Suspended in Fake MBBS Admissions Case

Two revenue sub-inspectors in Uttarakhand, Jagdish Rathore and Dimple, have been suspended following a preliminary inquiry into a case involving fake MBBS admissions. The case reportedly concerns the use of fraudulent freedom fighter certificates for admission to MBBS courses in 2025. A Special Investigation Team (SIT) has arrested two individuals in connection with the matter.
